decisions.statement: One kind is put up by this service, and the code beside this page names that kind.
A tick ends once the deploy it started ends, and the tick after it is skipped meanwhile.
The deploy runs in a scope of its own, so this service being started again leaves it running.
The deploy this starts puts this service up too, and starts it again where it changed.
A tick finding nothing changed starts nothing, so that is no loop without end.

definition: the service putting the workstation kind up once a commit changes what it is built from
